sermon.title: What Other Tools do we Have? — March 27, 2022
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: God’s goal is that we grow into His image. He gives tools: praise, repentance, baptism, the Holy Spirit, Scripture, Jesus’ death and resurrection, faith, and just leaders and parents. How shall we escape if we neglect so great a salvation?
